announcement.note: (Monday; WotC said so in the Oct 12, 2026 announcement)

estimates.why: P(act) ~57%: WotC's Oct 12 'very likely ... very hard look at the Eldrazi package' (~60%), +12 for the Eldrazi family at ~19% on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp #1 and up to 11.9%), Broodscale Bloodchief #1 on MTGTop8 (12% of 562 decks) and S-tier on Spellslinger (#1 at 9.6% share, 80 top 8s in 30 days, best conversion in the format), and another Challenge win on Nov 23 with two copies in the top 8; -15 for organic correction (Spellslinger effective archetypes still ~25 though falling from ~32; no Modern RC until April 2027, so no season to protect; no new WotC wording as of Nov 24). Goldfish and Spellslinger still disagree on how big the deck is, so this is not averaged. x P(Command picked) ~30%: Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief or Emrakul are the narrower enablers and Reddit mostly says 'just ban broodscale or blade'; the Command is a flexible 4-of in 19% of all Modern decks (#17 staple, also in Tron and Trudge decks), which WotC avoids hitting.
#38 Legacy staple in 12% of decks; WotC called Legacy Eldrazi proactive and fair. No ban pressure.
Not a Vintage restriction candidate; in Commander it is in 0.78% of EDHREC decks and not on the Game Changers list (Scryfall: 53 Game Changers, Command not among them).

summary: WotC's Oct 12 update warned it is 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package' if Eldrazi keeps sitting on top, and named Kozilek's Command as a bridge to Emrakul in Broodscale Combo. As of Nov 24 there is no new WotC word, and the deck is still #1 everywhere (MTGGoldfish Eldrazi Ramp 11.9%, MTGTop8 Broodscale Bloodchief 12%) and won the Nov 23 Challenge, so a Nov 30 hit on the archetype is a bit better than a coin flip. If WotC acts, Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief or Emrakul is the likelier pick; the Command is a real but secondary target.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (last 2 weeks)
sources.takeaway: 562 decks (last 2 weeks): Broodscale Bloodchief #1 at 12%, Rakdos Aggro 10%, UW Control 8%, Boros Aggro 7%, Affinity 7%.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (full)
sources.takeaway: Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 11.9% (up from 11.6%); Eldrazi-family decks ~19% combined (Eldrazi Tron 3.7%, Eldrazi 1.8%, Broodscale 0.8%+0.2%); Boros Energy 7.7%, Amulet Titan 7.3%.

sources.title: Modern Format Staples (spells)
sources.takeaway: Kozilek's Command #17 spell, 19% of decks (4.0 copies); Blade of the Bloodchief #36 (12%); Sowing Mycospawn, Emrakul and Basking Broodscale outside the top 50 spells.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 23)
sources.takeaway: 53 players, won by Broodscale Bloodchief (Emrakul, Eldrazi Temple list); a second Broodscale Bloodchief finished 3-4th.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 22)
sources.takeaway: 44 players, won by Boros Aggro; Broodscale Bloodchief finished 2nd, the only Eldrazi deck in the top 8.

sources.title: Legacy Format Staples
sources.takeaway: #38 Legacy staple, 12% of decks: no Legacy ban pressure.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 21)
sources.takeaway: 53 players, won by Broodscale Bloodchief (Eldrazi Temple, Emrakul list); no other Eldrazi deck in the top 8.

sources.title: r/ModernMagic: "Urza's Saga as a ban candidate" (top comment)
sources.takeaway: Most upvoted take (+22): 'just ban broodscale or blade and be done with it' rather than weakening many decks.

sources.title: Kozilek's Command
sources.takeaway: ~82K decks, 0.78% inclusion, not a Game Changer: no Commander ban pressure.

sources.title: Banned and Restricted Announcement - October 12, 2026
sources.takeaway: No Modern changes; 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package'; Command named as a bridge to Emrakul; next B&R Nov 30.
